tool_input.command: for f in backup.sh rotate.sh verify.sh restore.sh report.sh; do sed -n '/^# Option parsing/,/^}/p' "$f" | shasum -a 256; done
tool_input.description: Compare option-parsing blocks across scripts by checksum

result:
All checks pass. Summary of what changed:

- **`lib/common.sh`** (new): the shared option-parsing block (`--dest/--name/--keep/--quiet/--dry-run/--help`, `is_uint`, `need_value`, `ARGS`, `--keep` validation) and the `resolve_dir` helper, with a double-sourcing guard in the style of `lib/log.sh`.
- **`rotate.sh`**: sources `lib/common.sh` instead of repeating the parser/`resolve_dir`; bug fix — the list is sorted oldest-first, so surplus is now `head -n "$((total - keep))"` (was `tail -n +keep`, which deleted the keep-th-oldest *and* the newest, firing even at exactly N), and the no-op check is `total -le keep`.
- **`verify.sh`**: sources `lib/common.sh` likewise; bug fix — the sidecar's file name is now everything after the digest (spaces preserved, was `awk '{print $2}'` truncating at the first space), and the digest comparison is a quoted `[[ ]]` string compare.
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`**: one test per bug — `rotate --keep 3` with exactly 3 archives deletes nothing (all 3 remain), and `verify` reports `ok`/rc 0 for `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz`.

`bash tests/run_tests.sh`: 8/8 ok, "all tests passed". `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched; both refactored scripts keep accepting all the same flags (verified `--help`, `--dest=`, `--name` with spaces, unknown-option and `--keep 0` rejections).

Changed: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and added `lib/common.sh`.
